notes.title: F.E.X (Forced Evolution Experiment) update
notes.content:
Fixes:
 - We've added more enemies in areas that require them but didn't have any. 
 - The time in the flamethrowers has changes.
 - A time bar has been implemented to change age so if the player press the button by mistake it won't change.
 - The dialogues are placed in a more visible place.
